title: TQL-001 — SQL-inspired query syntax extensions
body:
## Goal
Make Adeo's existing query language feel more familiar to power users without exposing the underlying SQLite schema or turning search into unrestricted SQL.

## Scope
Extend the current parser/AST so SQL-like syntax compiles to the same internal query model used by existing Smart Lists, search and board behavior.

Proposed syntax:

```text
priority = high
tag = "work"
done = false
due <= today
text CONTAINS "invoice"
tag IN ("work", "urgent")
priority IN (high, medium)
due IS NULL
due IS NOT NULL
due BETWEEN 2026-10-01 AND 2026-10-31
```

Keep current syntax working as shorthand/backward-compatible aliases where practical:

```text
tag:work
#work
priority:high
details~invoice
```

## Principles
- Do not add `SELECT`, `FROM`, `JOIN` or direct arbitrary SQL execution.
- Do not expose physical table/column names.
- Preserve a controlled AST so Smart Lists remain analyzable.
- Preserve the ability to derive deterministic task properties from Smart List predicates for Quick Add and Board moves.
- New syntax should map to existing typed fields and operators rather than bypassing validation.

## Candidate operators / constructs
- `=` and `!=`
- `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`
- `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`
- `IN (...)`
- `IS NULL`, `IS NOT NULL`
- `CONTAINS`
- `BETWEEN ... AND ...`
- Parentheses

## Acceptance criteria
- Existing saved queries continue to work.
- SQL-like syntax and existing shorthand compile to equivalent AST semantics where they express the same condition.
- Query validation remains field-aware and produces useful errors/suggestions.
- Smart List template derivation still works for deterministic equality constraints.
- Board moves into Smart List columns can still infer and apply supported destination attributes.
- No raw SQL supplied by the user is executed against SQLite.

## Non-goal
A full SQL query interface over Adeo's persistence schema.
